summary: Map the /api/v3/ui/* soft 401 envelope to exit 4 on savedlists list and get.
reason: Woolworths runs two API generations. The newer /api/v3/ui/* surface answers HTTP 200 and buries auth failure in the body as {"success":false,"statusCode":401}, so savedlists exited 0 and looked like an empty-but-successful result. Session cookies are ~1-hour JWTs, so an expired session is the normal end state of every import; an agent could not distinguish it from 'you have no saved lists'. The check must sit before every output branch because savedlists list returns early via the human-table path.
validated_outcome: No session: savedlists list and get both exit 4 with a re-import hint. Valid session: list returns 9 lists and get returns 42 products, both exit 0. pastshops already exited 4 on its real HTTP 401 and was left alone.
